x-e-e3-03.thinking.2: Kọwaa ihe mere ikpe ụfọdụ anaghị arụ ọrụ
x-e-e3-03.topic: Ederede nke ahịrị 3-5 (akwụkwọ oku, usoro oge, akara)
x-e-e3-03.title: Chọta oge ịgụ akwụkwọ n'usoro oge Saturday nke Mina
x-e-e3-03.goal: Chee oge mmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ dị iche nke na-emezu ọnọdụ niile dị n'usoro oge, ma kọwaa ihe mere oge ndị ọzọ anaghị arụ ọrụ.
x-e-e3-03.material:
Usoro oge Saturday nke Mina (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

10 a.m.: I can start my free time.
12 p.m. - 1 p.m.: Lunch
1 p.m. - 2 p.m.: Dance class
5 p.m.: Dinner. I must finish before dinner.

Mina chọrọ ịgụ akwụkwọ awa 1. Ọ na-amalite n'awa zuru ezu ma na-akwụsị n'awa zuru ezu.
x-e-e3-03.thinking.0: Mee azịza nke na-emezu ọtụtụ ọnọdụ n'otu mgbe
x-e-e3-03.thinking.1: Chee echiche oge ndị na-agbakwụnye ibe ha
x-e-e3-03.prereq.0: Ịgụ oge a.m./p.m. (otú e si agbanwe ha ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24, dị ka 1 p.m. = 13, dị n'ihe ngosi)
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.prompt: N'usoro oge, kedu oge ndị enweghị ike ịgụ akwụkwọ? Họrọ niile kwesịrị ekwesị.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Gbanwee oge dị n'usoro oge ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ awa 24 ma see eserese oge.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa oge efu na oge juru.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.r.a: Lelee ahịrị mbụ nke usoro oge ka ịmata mgbe oge efu na-amalite.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.r.b: Lelee ma e nwere ọrụ e dere n'usoro oge n'oge ahụ.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.r.c: Lelee oge ahịrị nri ehihie na ahịrị ịgba egwu otu n'azụ nke ọzọ.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.r.d: Tụnyere ya na oge nri abalị. Lekwa ma ọrụ ọzọ ọ dị n'oge ahụ.
x-e-e3-03.s.s1.explain: Oge ezumike na-amalite na 10 a.m., ma 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ọrụ ọ bụla adịghị n'usoro oge site na 15 ruo 16 na site na 16 ruo 17, ma ha na-agwụ tupu nri abalị.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.prompt: Mee oge dị iche iche 3 (n'elekere zuru ezu) Mina nwere ike ịmalite ịgụ akwụkwọ. Dee ha dị ka ọnụọgụ elekere 24. (Ihe atụ: 3 p.m. = 15)
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.hint.0: 1 p.m. bụ 13, ma 5 p.m. bụ 17. Gbanwee oge niile dị n'usoro oge ka ha bụrụ ọnụọgụ elekere 24.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ọ na-agụ akwụkwọ elekere 1, ya mere ịgbakwunye 1 na oge mmalite na-enye oge njedebe.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.hint.2: Nri ehihie na ịgba egwu na-esochi ibe ha, ya mere lelee ma ọ nwere ike ịmalite n'ime oge ahụ.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.fail.c0: I kwesịrị ide ya n'elekere zuru ezu (1, 2, 3...).
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọ bụ mgbe oge ezumike malitere.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Tupu 10 a.m. ọ bụghị oge ezumike.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ọ bụrụ na ọ gụọ akwụkwọ elekere 1, ọ ga-agafe 5 p.m. (17).
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Ọ naghị adabere na nri ehihie ma ọ bụ ịgba egwu.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ọ na-adabere na nri ehihie (12 ruo 13) ma ọ bụ klaasị ịgba egwu (13 ruo 14).
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.explain: Ịgụ akwụkwọ ga-amalite mgbe 10 gasịrị ma gwụ tupu 17. Site na 12 ruo 14 jupụtara na nri ehihie na ịgba egwu. Ya mere ọ nwere ike ịmalite na 10, 11, 14, 15, ma ọ bụ 16.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.because.prompt: N'otu ahịrị okwu ma ọ bụ abụọ, dee ihe mere ọ na-ekwesịghị ịmalite na 12 ma ọ bụ 13, na-eji usoro oge dị ka ihe akaebe gị. Ị nwere ike ide n'asụsụ Korea ma ọ bụ Bekee.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta ihe dị n'usoro oge na 12.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lelee 13 otu ahụ, ma jikọta ha n'otu ahịrị okwu.
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị nwere ike ikwu ahịrị nke usoro oge ihe kpatara gị sitere?
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị kọwara site n'iji tụnyere oge ọzọ ọ nwere ike ịmalite (dịka ọmụmaatụ, 14)?
x-e-e3-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Na 12 e nwere nri ehihie ma na 13 e nwere klaasị ịgba egwu, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịgụ akwụkwọ n'oge ndị ahụ.

x-e-e3-05.topic: Ichee mmetụta na ihe kpatara ha
x-e-e3-05.title: Gosi 'nchegbu' n'enweghị ikwu ya
x-e-e3-05.goal: Dee obere ederede ebe onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee mmetụta site n'omume na ihe ngosi ahụ naanị, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta ọ bụla.
x-e-e3-05.material: Ị ga-ede ihe omume ebe enyi gị Mina na-echegbu onwe ya n'oge ule. Ederede na-ekwu mmetụta ozugbo na ederede na-egosi ya site n'omume na-eru onye na-agụ n'ụzọ dị iche.
x-e-e3-05.thinking.1: Dee site n'iji naanị ihe ngosi, n'enweghị okwu mmetụta
x-e-e3-05.thinking.2: Buo amụma ihe onye na-agụ ga-eche
x-e-e3-05.prereq.0: Okwu mmetụta dị ka worried, nervous, na scared
x-e-e3-05.prereq.1: Okwu dị mfe dị ka look, hand, na clock
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.prompt: Ederede atọ ahụ niile na-egosi naanị omume Mina, n'enweghị iji okwu mmetụta ọ bụla. Kedu ederede na-eme ka ị chee na Mina nọ "nervous" n'oge ule ahụ?
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Site na ederede atọ ọ bụla, họrọ ma dee omume Mina ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ahụ ya.
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.hint.1: Maka omume ọ bụla ị họọrọ, dee mmetụta ọ na-eme ka ị chee, ma tụnyere ya na mmetụta tupu ule.
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.r.a: Chee mmetụta omume a jikọtara na ya. Tụnyere ma otu "looking out the window" ahụ na-ejikọta na nchegbu.
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.r.b: Chee mmetụta omume a jikọtara na ya. Tụnyere ma ọ dabara n'ọdịdị onye na-echegbu onwe ya.
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ụzọ mgbanwe ahụ na omume ugboro ugboro si aghọ ihe ngosi nke nchegbu.
x-e-e3-05.s.s1.explain: Site n'aka oyi na ịlele elekere ugboro ugboro, onye na-agụ nwere ike ichee nchegbu. Ịmị ọnụ mgbe ọ na-ele window na-egosi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma ịmụmụ ọnụ ọchị mgbe ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa na-egosi udo ma ọ bụ ntụkwasị obi.
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.prompt: Na-ejighị okwu 'worried', dee ahịrị okwu Bekee abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ na-egosi onye na-echegbu onwe ya. Mee ka enyi na-agụ ya nwee ike ichee 'she is worried'.
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.hint.0: Chee otú onye na-echegbu onwe ya si eme ihe na ihe ọ na-ele.
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dee otu omume n'otu ahịrị okwu, wee jikọta abụọ ma ọ bụ atọ n'ime ha.
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Enyi na-agụ ederede gị nwere ike ichee ya n'enweghị onye kwuru okwu 'worry'?
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Omume ọ bụla ọ na-adaba na nchegbu?
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị chere ma otu ihe ngosi ahụ nwere ike ịgụ dị ka mmetụta dị iche (ọṅụ, ike ọgwụgwụ)?
x-e-e3-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ na-egosi mmetụta site n'ide naanị ihe ngosi omume.

x-e-e3-01.title: Kwekọọ azịza Ben na akwụkwọ oku ncheta ụbọchị ọmụmụ
x-e-e3-01.topic: Ederede nke ahịrị 3-5 (akwụkwọ oku, usoro oge, akara)
x-e-e3-01.goal: Lelee azịza Ben megide ahịrị ọ bụla nke akwụkwọ oku, ma gwa ya n'asụsụ Bekee akụkụ ndị na-adabaghị, na-enye ihe akaebe gị.
x-e-e3-01.material:
Akwụkwọ oku ncheta ụbọchị ọmụmụ (e dere n'ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

You are invited to Yuna's birthday party!
Date: Saturday, June 7. Time: 2 p.m. to 4 p.m.
Place: Yuna's house.
Please bring a small gift. No pets, please.

Enyi gị Ben zigara azịza. "I can come to the party on Sunday with my puppy and my sister."
x-e-e3-01.thinking.0: Tụnyere ahịrị ọ bụla nke akwụkwọ oku na mpempe ọ bụla nke azịza
x-e-e3-01.thinking.1: Kewaa akụkụ ndị dị mma na akụkụ ndị bụ nsogbu
x-e-e3-01.thinking.2: Idozi mmadụ n'ụzọ nkwanye ùgwù, na-enye ihe akaebe
x-e-e3-01.prereq.0: Okwu ụbọchị dị ka Saturday na Sunday
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ akụkụ niile nke azịza Ben nke na-adabaghị na akwụkwọ oku.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa azịza Ben n'mpempe: 'onye ya na ya', 'gịnị', na 'mgbe'. Mgbe ahụ kwekọọ mpempe ọ bụla na ahịrị nke akwụkwọ oku.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Maka mpempe ọ bụla nke ozi Ben, chọta ahịrị akwụkwọ oku nke na-ekpuchi ya ma kaa ya dị ka otu n'ime "otu / dị iche / enweghị ahịrị kwekọrọ."
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.r.a: Tinye ahịrị 'No pets, please.' n'akụkụ okwu Ben ma tụnyere ha.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.r.b: Chọpụta ma akwụkwọ oku nwere ahịrị banyere onye nwere ike ịbịa ya na ya. Ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị ihe ọ na-ekwu, kewaa ma nke ahụ bụ adịghị nkwekọ ma ọ bụ ihe chọrọ nlele.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.r.c: Tụnyere ụbọchị e dere n'ahịrị Date na ụbọchị Ben kwuru.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.r.d: Ịzaghachi na ọ ga-abịa dị n'otu ụzọ ahụ ihe akwụkwọ oku chọrọ.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.explain: Oriri ahụ bụ na Saturday ma a anabataghị anụ ụlọ, ma Ben kwuru na ọ na-abịa na Sunday na nwa nkịta ya. Akwụkwọ oku ekwughị ihe ọ bụla banyere nwanne ya nwanyị, ya mere enweghị ike ịkpọ ya adịghị nkwekọ; ọ bụ ihe ị ga-ajụ Yuna. Ikwu na ọ ga-abịa dị mma.
x-e-e3-01.s.s1.acc.0: Akwụkwọ oku ekwughị ihe ọ bụla banyere nwanne nwanyị, ya mere ịnweghị ike ikwu n'ezie na ọ bụ adịghị nkwekọ, ma ọ bụkwa ihe ezi uche dị na ya iwere onye a na-akpọghị ịbịa dị ka nsogbu ma gụọ ya dị ka ihe ị ga-ajụ Yuna mbụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị kewara adịghị nkwekọ na ihe chọrọ nlele, nke ahụ bụ ezi ikpe.
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.prompt: Zaghachi Ben n'ahịrịokwu Bekee otu ma ọ bụ abụọ. Gwa ya ihe abụọ na-adabaghị.
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee otu nsogbu n'otu ahịrịokwu.
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.hint.1: N'ahịrịokwu nke abụọ, dee nsogbu nke ọzọ. Nwaa iji okwu sitere n'akwụkwọ oku (Saturday, pets, wdg.).
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nwere ike ikwu ahịrị akwụkwọ oku nsogbu abụọ gị ọ bụla sitere na ya?
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ebe ma nwanne nwanyị nwere ike ịbịa bụ ozi na-adịghị n'akwụkwọ oku, ị kewara ya dị ka "ihe ị ga-ajụ" kama "adịghị nkwekọ"? (Nhọrọ)
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị gwara Ben okwu n'ụzọ nke na-agaghị emerụ mmetụta ya?
x-e-e3-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ dị mkpụmkpụ, ma ọ na-agwa nsogbu abụọ ahụ.

x-e-e3-02.topic: Ederede nke ahịrị 3-5 (akwụkwọ oku, usoro oge, akara)
x-e-e3-02.title: Họrọ ahịrị ịchọrọ site na akara ụlọ ụtọ achịcha
x-e-e3-02.goal: Kewaa ahịrị akara nke achọrọ n'ezie iji zaa ajụjụ ahụ na ahịrị ndị na-adịghị mkpa, ma mgbe ahụ tinye ahịrị ndị ahụ ọnụ iji ruo nkwubi okwu.
x-e-e3-02.material:
Akara ụlọ ụtọ achịcha (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, na-enweghị ihe oyiyi):

Happy Bakery
Open: Tuesday - Sunday, 8 a.m. - 7 p.m.
Bread: 2 dollars. Cake: 15 dollars.
Free milk with any cake (until 12 p.m.).

Minsu nwere dollar 20. Ọ chọrọ ịga na Wednesday na 1 p.m., zụta otu keekị, ma nweta mmiri ara ehi n'efu.
x-e-e3-02.thinking.0: Kewaa ozi ịchọrọ maka ajụjụ ahụ na ozi ịchọghị
x-e-e3-02.thinking.1: Tinye ọtụtụ ahịrị ọnụ iji ruo nkwubi okwu

x-e-e3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa ajụjụ Minsu n'mpempe atọ: 'Ọ̀ meghere?', 'Ego ọ̀ zuru?', na 'Mmiri ara ehi ọ̀ bụ n'efu?'
x-e-e3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta otu ahịrị nwere azịza maka mpempe ọ bụla.
x-e-e3-02.s.s1.r.a: Ị nwere ike ịmata ma ụlọ ahịa meghere na Wednesday na 1 p.m. naanị site n'itụnyere ya na ahịrị a.
x-e-e3-02.s.s1.r.b: Minsu chọrọ ịzụta keekị naanị. Chee echiche ma ozi dị n'ahịrị a na-agbanwe nkwubi okwu.
x-e-e3-02.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ahịrị e ji ekpebi ma dollar 20 zuru iji zụta keekị.
x-e-e3-02.s.s1.r.d: Ma mmiri ara ehi bụ n'efu metụtara oge. Tụnyere ya na oge Minsu na-aga.

x-e-e3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Lelee ụbọchị mmeghe, ego, na oge mmiri ara ehi otu n'otu, ma kwupụta nkwubi okwu gị ugboro atọ.
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tụnyere ma 'until 12 p.m.' bụ tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe 1 p.m.
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.o.a: Ọ bụrụ na ị zụta keekị, ị nwetakwa mmiri ara ehi n'efu
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.r.a: Ị nwere ike ịbụ na ị hapụrụ ndetu oge dị na njedebe nke ahịrị mmiri ara ehi.
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.o.b: Ụlọ ahịa emechiri, ya mere ịnweghị ike ịzụta ihe ọ bụla
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.r.b: Lelee ọzọ ma ụbọchị na awa dị n'ahịrị Open gụnyere oge Minsu na-aga.
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.o.c: Dollar 20 ezughị, ya mere ịnweghị ike ịzụta keekị
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.r.c: Tụnyere ọnụ ahịa keekị na ego Minsu ozugbo.
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.o.d: Ọ nwere ike ịzụta keekị ahụ, ma mmiri ara ehi abụghị n'efu
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.r.d: Nke a bụ echiche nke na-etinye ahịrị atọ ahụ ọnụ ma na-elelekwa ọnọdụ oge.
x-e-e3-02.s.s2.explain: Wednesday bụ ụbọchị mmeghe, ma 1 p.m. dị tupu 7 p.m., ya mere ụlọ ahịa meghere. Keekị bụ dollar 15, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịzụta ya na dollar 20. Ma mmiri ara ehi n'efu bụ naanị ruo 12 noon, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịnweta ya na 1 p.m.

x-e-e3-04.prereq.0: Okwu mmetụta dị ka happy, sad, sorry, na angry
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.prompt: Gụọ otu ihe omume n'otu oge ma chee otú Jun si eche. Mgbe ihe omume ọhụrụ pụtara, ị nwere ike ịgbanwe echiche gị nke mbụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Jiri naanị ihe Jun na-ekwu na ihe ọ na-eme n'ihe omume a dị ka ihe akaebe gị.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tụkọta echiche gị site n'ihe omume gara aga n'akụkụ ihe ngosi ị nwere ugbu a ma tụnyere ha.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu otú Jun nwere ike ịbụ ugbu a?
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kedu otú Jun nwere ike ịbụ ugbu a?
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Jun meriri ihe nrite wee wụlie elu, ya mere ọ dị ya mma kacha dabara.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Chee ma 'jumps up' na 'won first prize' na-adabara ọmịiko.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Okwu ya na omume ya bụ ihe ngosi na-atụ aka n'otu ụzọ ahụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Chọta okwu ma ọ bụ omume ọ bụla ga-eme ka ị chee na ọ na-ewe iwe.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Lelee ma ọ na-adaba na 'jumps up'.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ikwu okwu nwayọọ na itinye akwụkwọ ozi n'akpa ya bụ omume na-agbalị ọ ghara igosi ọ joyful ya. Ị nwere ike ikwu na obi ụtọ ya agwakọtara na mmetụta ọ na-ewute ya.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ na-eche na ọ bụ ihe okike na Ara tụfuru
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tụnyere okwu na omume Jun ka ị hụ ma "I am sorry" pụtara nke ahụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ka ọ bụ naanị obi ụtọ
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tụnyere ka ikwu okwu nwayọọ na itinye akwụkwọ ozi n'akpa si dị iche n'ihe omume gara aga.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Obi ụtọ, ma ọ na-ewute ya maka Ara
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Nke a bụ echiche na-akọwa okwu na omume ọhụrụ niile.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Obi adịghịzi ya mma ma ọlị maka imeri ihe nrite
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Jun tụfuru akwụkwọ ozi ahụ, ka ọ tinyere ya n'akpa? Chọta ihe ngosi na-egosi na ọ joyful ya ahụ ejirila kpamkpam.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: N'ihi okwu ndị a, kedu otú Jun si eche banyere Ara?
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ọ sịrị ka anyị se eserese ọnụ na ọ chọrọ ịhụ eserese Ara, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhụ na ọ na-eche maka Ara.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lee onye okwu Jun tụrụ aro bụ maka ya.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ọ chọrọ igosi na ọ meriri ihe nrite
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Lelee ma okwu Jun kwuru na-ekwu banyere ihe nrite ahụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ọ chọrọ ịsọ mpi na Ara ma merie ọzọ
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Chee ma "I want to see your picture" bụ okwu iji merie ya ma ọ bụ oku ka ha se eserese ọnụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s1.reflect: N'ihe omume nke abụọ, n'ihi ihe ngosi ọhụrụ 'quietly' na 'put the letter in his bag', echiche gị gbanwere site na 'obi ụtọ' ruo 'obi ụtọ + mmetụta ọ na-ewute ya'. Ka ihe ngosi sitere n'okwu na omume na-aba ụba, otu echiche gị banyere mmetụta na-aghọ nke ziri ezi karị.
x-e-e3-04.s.s2.prompt: Dee mmetụta Jun n'otu ahịrị okwu Bekee ma ọ bụ abụọ, ma gụnye otu ihe ngosi sitere n'akụkọ ahụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ họrọ otu okwu mmetụta.
x-e-e3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Jikọọ ya site na because n'ihe Jun kwuru ma ọ bụ mere nke mere i ji họrọ okwu ahụ.
x-e-e3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nwere ike ikwu okwu ma ọ bụ omume nke akụkọ ahụ okwu mmetụta dị n'ederede gị sitere?

x-e-e3-07.topic: Ichee mmetụta na ihe kpatara ha
x-e-e3-07.title: Chee ihe kpatara site n'ndetu Tom
x-e-e3-07.goal: Jiri ihe ngosi dị n'ndetu ahụ chee ihe kpatara Tom ji anọghị n'ịnya igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ ya, ma kpebie nkọwa nwere ihe akaebe karị.
x-e-e3-07.material:
Ndetu Tom hapụrụ n'elu tebụl kichin (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Mom, I am at the park.
I took my umbrella and my coat.
I did not take my bike.
Back at 5.

Hana kwuru, "It's because Tom's bike is broken," ma Jinwoo kwuru, "It's because it is raining outside."
x-e-e3-07.thinking.0: Kpebie nkọwa abụọ ahụ nke nwere ihe akaebe karị
x-e-e3-07.thinking.1: Jiri okwu nlezianya maka echiche na-adịghị n'aka
x-e-e3-07.prereq.1: Ihe I think, maybe, na probably pụtara
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.prompt: Site n'ozi dị n'ndetu ahụ, kedu n'ime nkọwa abụọ ahụ nwere ihe akaebe karị?
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.hint.0: Chọta otu ahịrị nke ndetu ahụ na-akwado nkọwa ọ bụla.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa nkọwa nwere ahịrị na-akwado ya na nkọwa na-eche ihe na-adịghị n'ndetu ahụ.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.o.a: N'ihi na Tom hụrụ ije n'anya
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.r.a: Chọpụta ma ndetu ahụ na-ekwu ihe dị otú ahụ.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.o.b: Nkọwa "it is broken" nwere ihe akaebe karị. A kpọtụrụ igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ aha
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.r.b: Ndetu ahụ anaghị ekwu na igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ ahụ agbajiela; ọ na-ekwu naanị na ọ nyaghị ya.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.o.c: Nkọwa Jinwoo nwere ihe akaebe karị. Ọ bụ n'ihi na ọ butere umbrella
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.r.c: Ihe ngosi dị n'ndetu ahụ jikọtara na nkọwa ahụ. Ma, na umbrella nwere ike ịbụ n'ihi mmiri ozuzo bụ echiche.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.o.d: Abụọ bụ otu. Ị nweghị ike ichee ihe kpatara ya ma ọlị site n'ndetu ahụ
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.r.d: Gụghachi ndetu ahụ ahịrị n'ahịrị ka ị hụ ma ahịrị ọ bụla na-enye gị ohere ichee ihe kpatara ya.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.explain: Umbrella na coat bụ ihe ngosi gbasara ihu igwe, ma ndetu ahụ anaghị ekwu ihe ọ bụla gbasara agbajiri agbaji. Ya mere nkọwa Jinwoo nwere ihe akaebe karị, ma ọ bụghị n'aka.
x-e-e3-07.s.s1.acc.0: Mkpebi nlezianya na-egosi na enweghị ike ikpebi ihe kpatara ya site n'ndetu ahụ naanị. Ma n'ihi na e nwere ihe ngosi nke umbrella, o siri ike ikwu na enweghị ike ichee ya ma ọlị.
x-e-e3-07.s.s2.prompt: N'otu ahịrị okwu Bekee ma ọ bụ abụọ, chee ihe kpatara Tom ji anọghị n'ịnya igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ ya. Gụnye otu ihe ngosi sitere n'ndetu ahụ, ma jiri okwu na-egosi na ị nweghị n'aka (I think, maybe, wdg).
x-e-e3-07.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta okwu abụọ gbasara ihu igwe n'ndetu ahụ.
x-e-e3-07.s.s2.hint.1: Mee ahịrị okwu site n'itinye echiche gị n'usoro 'I think ... because ...'.
x-e-e3-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nwere ike ikwu ahịrị nke ndetu ahụ ihe kpatara gị sitere?
x-e-e3-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị chere banyere ohere nke ihe kpatara ọzọ (dịka ọmụmaatụ, umbrella bụ maka anwụ)?
x-e-e3-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ọ jikọtara ihe ngosi dị n'ahịrị okwu nke abụọ.

x-e-e3-06.title: Kwekọọ ọkwa njem ụlọ akwụkwọ na ozi Soyun
x-e-e3-06.goal: Tụnyere ọkwa ahụ na ozi enyi, chọta ahịrị na-emegide ya, ma deghachi ya n'asụsụ Bekee.
x-e-e3-06.material:
Ọkwa njem ụlọ akwụkwọ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Field Trip
Date: Thursday, April 10. Meet at the school gate at 8:30 a.m.
Bring: lunch, water, and a hat.
Back at school: 3 p.m.

Soyun zigara enyi ya Eunwoo ozi. Lelee ya n'okpuru, otu ahịrị n'otu oge.
x-e-e3-06.thinking.0: Tụnyere ozi dị n'ederede abụọ ahụ ahịrị n'ahịrị
x-e-e3-06.thinking.1: Kewaa mgbagha na ihe a hapụrụ naanị
x-e-e3-06.prereq.1: Okwu dị ka Thursday, gate, na lunch
x-e-e3-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ otu ahịrị dị n'ozi Soyun nke na-adabaghị na ọkwa ahụ.
x-e-e3-06.s.s1.hint.0: Jikọta ahịrị Date, Meet, Bring, na Back nke ọkwa ahụ na ahịrị Soyun, otu n'otu.
x-e-e3-06.s.s1.hint.1: N'ime ahịrị ndị na-ekwu otu ihe, chọta nke ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ ụbọchị dị iche.
x-e-e3-06.s.s1.explain: Ọkwa ahụ sịrị ka a zute na 8:30, ma Soyun kwuru 9:30 n'ahịrị 2. Ahịrị 1 (Thursday) na ahịrị 4 (back at 3) dị ka ọkwa ahụ. Ahịrị 3 hapụrụ mmiri, ma ọ megideghị ihe ọkwa ahụ kwuru.
x-e-e3-06.s.s2.prompt: Kama Soyun, deghachi ahịrị 2 n'otu ahịrị okwu Bekee ka ọ dabara n'ọkwa ahụ.
x-e-e3-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gụọ ahịrị Meet nke ọkwa ahụ dị ka o si dị.
x-e-e3-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye oge na ebe sitere n'ahịrị ahụ iji mezue ahịrị okwu 'We meet ...'.
x-e-e3-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Oge ị mezigharịrị ọ bụ otu ahụ na ahịrị Meet nke ọkwa ahụ?
x-e-e3-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị dozịrị naanị ahịrị nsogbu ahụ, n'enweghị imetụ ahịrị ndị ọzọ aka?
x-e-e3-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza dị mma nwere mgbaghara agbakwunyere.

x-e-e3-08.title: Ndetu abụọ nwere ụbọchị ọmụmụ piano dị iche
x-e-e3-08.goal: Kewaa akụkụ ndị bụ otu na ndị na-emegide ibe ha n'ndetu abụọ, ma họrọ ajụjụ ga-egosi nke ziri ezi.
x-e-e3-08.material:
"Ndetu abụọ (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Note 1 (Dad stuck it on the fridge)
Mina, piano lesson is Wednesday at 4 p.m. Take your music book.

Note 2 (a message from Ms. Park at the music academy)
Hello Mina! Your piano lesson is Tuesday at 4 p.m. Please come five minutes early."
x-e-e3-08.thinking.0: Ikewa ihe na-adabara na mgbagha n'ederede abụọ
x-e-e3-08.thinking.2: Ikpe ma ajụjụ na-enyere mkpebi aka
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ihe niile ndetu abụọ ahụ na-ekwu n'otu ụzọ.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye ndetu abụọ ahụ n'tebụl kewara n'ime 'ọmụmụ kedu', 'ụbọchị kedu', 'oge kedu', na 'ihe ị ga-eweta'.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta ebe e dere okwu dị iche n'otu igbe.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.r.a: Tinye ụbọchị ndị dị n'Note 1 na Note 2 n'akụkụ ibe ha ma tụnyere ha ozugbo.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.r.b: Lelee ọmụmụ kedu ndetu abụọ ahụ na-ekwu gbasara.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.r.c: Tụnyere naanị akụkụ oge nke ndetu abụọ ahụ.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.r.d: Kwuo ma ọ dị n'otu ndetu naanị ma ọ bụ n'ndetu abụọ.
x-e-e3-08.s.s1.explain: Ndetu abụọ ahụ gbasara ọmụmụ piano ma na-ekwu na ọ na-amalite na 4 p.m. Ụbọchị dị iche. Ihe a ga-eweta (akwụkwọ egwu) na ịbịa n'oge dị n'otu ndetu naanị, ya mere ha abụghị mgbagha.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.prompt: Kedu ajụjụ ga-egosi ma Wednesday ma ọ bụ Tuesday ziri ezi?
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Chetaa ọzọ ebe ndetu abụọ ahụ na-emegide ibe ha.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma azịza ajụjụ ọ bụla na-edozi na 'Tuesday' ma ọ bụ 'Wednesday'.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.r.a: Nke a bụ ajụjụ na-ajụ ozugbo gbasara akụkụ na-emegide ibe ya.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.r.b: Ọbụna ma ị jụọ ihe ị ga-eweta, a naghị edozi ụbọchị ọmụmụ. Lelee ma ajụjụ ahụ na-edozi mgbagha.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.r.c: Oge bụ otu n'ndetu abụọ ahụ ugbu a. Chee ma ajụjụ ahụ na-ajụ gbasara akụkụ ebe mgbagha dị.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.r.d: Ebe a abụghị nsogbu n'ndetu abụọ ahụ.
x-e-e3-08.s.s2.explain: Mgbagha sitere n'ụbọchị, ya mere naanị ajụjụ na-ajụ ozugbo gbasara ụbọchị na-edozi nsogbu ahụ. Oge, ihe a ga-eweta, na ebe bụ otu ugbu a ma ọ bụ abụghị mgbagha. Ọ kacha mma ịjụ Ms. Park, onye na-edozi ọmụmụ.

x-e-e3-09.title: Zaghachi n'ụzọ dị iche n'oku maka mmadụ abụọ
x-e-e3-09.goal: Dee otu ọdịnaya ahụ (ekele, ihe mere i ji apụghị ịbịa, aro oge dị iche) n'asụsụ Bekee, na-agbanwe ụda gị maka enyi na maka okenye.
x-e-e3-09.material:
"Ozi site n'enyi gị Sam (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):
"Can you come to my house on Saturday at 10 a.m.? We can play games."

Ị nwere klaasị n'elekere 10 n'ụbọchị ahụ, ya mere ị pụghị ịga, ma ị nwere ike ịga na 2 p.m. Tinye atọ a niile n'nzaghachi gị.
1) Say thank you for the invitation
2) Say why you cannot go at 10
3) Suggest a different time"
x-e-e3-09.thinking.0: Nzaghachi nwere ọnọdụ niile n'ime ya
x-e-e3-09.thinking.1: Gbanwee ụda gị ka o dabara onye na-anata ya
x-e-e3-09.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dị ka Thank you, can't, na Could I ...?
x-e-e3-09.s.s1.prompt: Buru ụzọ dee nzaghachi Bekee otu ma ọ bụ abụọ nye Sam n'ụda enyi. Gụnye ọnọdụ atọ niile.
x-e-e3-09.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee ọnọdụ atọ ahụ iche, otu ahịrị okwu nke ọ bụla.
x-e-e3-09.s.s1.hint.1: Jikọta ahịrị okwu i dere iche n'ụda ị ga-eji eziga enyi.
x-e-e3-09.s.s1.selfAssess.0: Ị gụnyere ọnọdụ atọ niile (ekele, ihe mere i ji apụghị ịga, oge dị iche)?
x-e-e3-09.s.s1.selfAssess.1: Ụda ahụ dị mkpụmkpụ ma dị jụụ, dabara enyi?
x-e-e3-09.s.s1.modelNote.1: Nzaghachi dị mkpụmkpụ ma dị ọbụbụenyi.
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.prompt: Oge a, dee otu ọdịnaya ahụ n'asụsụ Bekee n'ụzọ dị mma nye nne Sam. Debe ọnọdụ atọ ahụ dị ka ha dị ma gbanwee naanị ụda gị.
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.hint.0: N'ederede maka enyi gị, chọta naanị otu okwu ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ka ọ bụrụ nke dị mma karịa.
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.hint.1: Nwaa itinye opekata mpe otu n'ime please, could, would, na I'm sorry.
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: E nwere okwu dị mma karịa n'ederede i dere nye enyi gị?
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ọnọdụ atọ ahụ ka dị niile?
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị gbanwere naanị okwu, dị ka ịgbanwe 'Can I' ka ọ bụrụ 'Could I'?
x-e-e3-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: O bulitere ịdị mma site n'iji 'I'm afraid' na 'Would'.

x-e-e3-10.title: Mee nzaghachi maka ndebanye aha nri nke oriri klaasị
x-e-e3-10.goal: Mee obere nzaghachi nwere nri ị họrọ, na-edebe ọnọdụ atọ niile.
x-e-e3-10.material:
'Ọkwa oriri klaasị (e dere dị ka ederede naanị, n'enweghị eserese):

Class Party on Friday!
Please reply to Ms. Lee by Wednesday.
1) Say one food you will bring.
2) The food must have no nuts.
3) Say how many people the food is for.'
x-e-e3-10.thinking.0: Idee ka ị na-elele ọnọdụ otu n'otu
x-e-e3-10.thinking.1: Izute ọnọdụ site n'ọdịnaya ị kpebiri
x-e-e3-10.prereq.0: Ngwa ọrụ dị mfe dị ka bring na make
x-e-e3-10.prereq.1: Ihe nuts pụtara, na ikwu ọnụọgụ mmadụ (for ten people)
x-e-e3-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu n'ime nzaghachi ndị a na-edebe ọnọdụ atọ niile?
x-e-e3-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kee ọnọdụ 1, 2, na 3 iche, ma lelee nzaghachi ọ bụla megide ha.
x-e-e3-10.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta nzaghachi na-efu otu ọnọdụ ma ọ bụ na-emegide otu.
